memory_update.text: Highest-priority direct grid equipment candidates for this node: ETN, GEV, ABB, HUBB, POWL, with AMSC as a smaller/niche grid power electronics candidate requiring market-cap and financial-quality checks.
Second-order but important installation and execution bottleneck candidates: PWR and MYRG, because transmission, distribution, and substation equipment must be physically engineered and installed.

Grid power equipment exposure should be separated into: direct OEM hardware, grid automation/software, installation/EPC services, electrical materials/components, and regulated utility demand validators.

Some global leaders in transformers, HVDC, and switchgear may be non-US-listed or OTC-only, including Siemens Energy, Schneider Electric, Hitachi Energy parent Hitachi, and Mitsubishi Electric; they may be important for industry evidence but may fall outside the US-listed screen.
Need a follow-up market-cap and listing-quality validation pass for smaller or less pure candidates, especially AMSC, AZZ, and any OTC ADRs considered later.

Falsification checks for the node should focus on utility capex deferrals, normalization of transformer/switchgear lead times, price competition from overseas capacity, margin compression, cancellation of data-center interconnection requests, and project execution bottlenecks shifting away from equipment vendors.

node: Grid power equipment: transformers, switchgear, breakers, protection relays, substations, HVDC, power electronics
summary: Expanded US-listed universe for the grid power equipment chokepoint. The highest-relevance names are direct electrical equipment OEMs and grid technology suppliers exposed to transformers, switchgear, substations, HVDC, grid automation, protection, and utility/data-center electrical capex. Second-order names include transmission/substation construction contractors, grid-edge software providers, electrical infrastructure materials suppliers, and regulated transmission owners whose capex can validate demand but may not capture equipment margin directly.
